title: Leaf radio duty cycle under TSCH (firmware-side energest) on EMULATED nRF52840-DK

test.description: Node 1 = RPL root + TSCH coordinator; node 2 = leaf. Both report firmware-side energest every 20 s. The number of interest is the LEAF's Radio Rx (idle-listening) duty cycle in permil -- expected to be a few percent under duty-cycled TSCH. Passes once the leaf has printed >=2 period summaries.
